query: Remove the AI slop from this generated B2B SaaS landing page. It has stacked gradients, a grid background, a giant wordmark, repeated CTA blocks, fake logo proof, an unreadable dashboard in browser chrome, and decorative monospace. Keep the yellow CTA that belongs to the brand.
expected_behavior: Selects Refine mode and edits the current UI instead of regenerating it
Deletes unsupported proof, repeated conversion furniture, and faux product framing before styling
Preserves the earned yellow brand moment instead of banning every strong visual choice
Uses authentic product behavior or legible product imagery as proof
Runs the final desktop and mobile anti-slop render gate

query: Simplify this analytics screen. Four cards are selectable choices and the fifth is reference context, but all five look clickable. The leaf duplicates the shell title and Done action, selection disappears after hover, and the sticky footer hides the final row.
expected_behavior: Selects Refine mode and follows Delete, Structure, System, Surface, States, Render
Keeps shared title and Done controls under one visual owner
Gives the reference context a quieter non-interactive treatment than the four choices
Adds a persistent accessible selected state distinct from hover
Scroll-tests the final content against sticky chrome at desktop and mobile widths

query: Refactor this settings page to match the supplied product reference. Search, filters, table, page size, and pagination form one module. Keep the product screenshot legible and the account form compact.
expected_behavior: Treats the live project and supplied reference as the spec instead of applying generic visual motifs
Allows a bounded table shell because the controls and table form one module
Keeps the product screenshot straight-on and readable without decorative perspective or fake chrome
Sizes the account form to its task rather than filling the available canvas
Uses project type, colour, radius, spacing, and depth tokens unless an optical exception is justified
